subject.title: [Feature]: When messages are merged and processed, the agent event is expected to carry the original runId(s)

question: What public Gateway event contract should represent merged queued-run lineage for clients: an additive original/source run ID array, one selected queued run ID, or a different correlation model?
rationale: The code can carry the internal IDs, but the permanent API semantics affect stable Gateway events and downstream client correlation behavior.

options.title: Additive lineage field
options.body: Add a new optional array field such as `originalRunIds` or `sourceRunIds` while keeping the executed `runId` canonical.

options.title: Canonical queued ID selection
options.body: Reuse the first or last queued run ID as the merged run identity, accepting that this changes current correlation semantics.

options.title: Defer protocol change
options.body: Keep current events unchanged and document external clients must correlate by another supported surface until a broader telemetry design lands.

recommendation.title: Additive lineage field
recommendation.body: Add a new optional array field such as `originalRunIds` or `sourceRunIds` while keeping the executed `runId` canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the clearest feature-history connection to the steering queue and Gateway protocol surfaces that need the API decision.
